g.title: The final relay doublet translates in X and Y for nodding and fine guiding.
The final element of the first NIR relay doublet is the vacuum window.
First pre-optic, before the ADC and field rotator.
The final relay doublet translates in X and Y for nodding and fine guiding.
A cold shortpass filter and baffle exclude warm infrared background.
Filter selection applies to the V channel.
